metadata.public_export_scope: Questions, original expected summaries, AI judgments, citation identifiers, metadata and hashes; no source-body reproduction or private absolute paths.
metadata.invalid_rubric_policy: Keep frozen case and original expectations unchanged; exclude entire R3-17 from scoring. Do not retrospectively narrow the rubric to S1.

scoring_definitions.pass: All material frozen question points answered with applicable evidence or specifically justified boundary.
scoring_definitions.partial: At least one material question point answered; another material point remains unaddressed.
scoring_definitions.fail: Core question unanswered, wrong target/source, or wrong scientific conclusion.
scoring_definitions.incorrect_support_label: Full evidence-supported/answered label despite wrong target/source or material missing part.
scoring_definitions.evidence_inapplicable: Citation block does not support the user-requested target as presented; truth of a different source/background claim is insufficient.
scoring_definitions.not_scored: R3-17 invalid frozen rights rubric; retained without a product verdict.
